limits: This uses actual AVAudioEngine rendering with production scene/input/clock/audio code, but an offscreen main-run-loop display timer.
No visible presentation, physical controller actuation, or continuous speaker audibility is established by this run.
Underruns, clock gaps and backlog recoveries are retained as failures; the near-real-time average does not imply smooth playback.

measurement.postRouteInput: Neutral input after the last authored step, using VTReplay.input unchanged.

scheduling.scope: Requested pthread QoS and Foundation thread properties; these do not measure effective scheduling priority or CPU-core placement.

measurement.scope: Offscreen main-run-loop VTScene/VTFrameClock/VTGame/VTAudioOutput producer and real AVAudioEngine pacing; no visible window, display presentation, physical controller or audible-speaker proof.
measurement.timingMetricsScope: updateWallSeconds, maximumUpdateSeconds and maximumCallbackGapSeconds include all scene callbacks, including continuations; displayCallback fields measure only the laboratory display timer. No per-event trace is installed.
